model.name: DropDispatcher.feedbackCycle
model.description: Manages the drop-zone UX state machine: idle→dragover(highlight)→uploading(statusbar with progress)→complete(system message success/fail). Progress via XMLHttpRequest.upload.onprogress or fetch+ReadableStream. System messages owned by RawBin user (00000000-0000-4000-8000-rawbin000000).
